messages:
matt: Heads-up: deploy-bot applied a soft throttle to v3.7.0 for /embeddings. p95 latency spiked ~+42% over baseline. thinking: brief stabilize window or manual rollback/pin. who (ops?)

deploy-bot: [automated] Throttle applied to rollout v3.7.0. Current traffic: 20%. Trigger: embeddings_p95_delta >= 40% (5m). Suggested actions: wait 10-15m; route-split to fallback; manual rollback to v3.6.2 (/deploy rollback).

sara: i'm digging into traces. errors not increasing, traces show kv hotpath stalls after quant kernel change. my read: likely perf regression, not infra flake. vote: route split and monitor 10-15m.

ops-oncall: i'm on. agree route-split first. if p95 > +30% at t+15m -> manual rollback. prefer rolling embeddings route only if we can safely split.

emily: i can cut a traffic split for embeddings in ~5m. can do 80/20 -> v3.7.0/v3.6.2 and watch. will also prep pin command and rollback snippet.

jordan: i'll draft a short customer note: "We've applied temporary traffic reduction due to observed embeddings latency. We're monitoring and will rollback if not resolved." will post to product-updates if we execute rollback.

matt: plan: emily, do 80/20 split now; sara+matt watch traces; ops-oncall ready to run rollback if t+15m threshold. deploy-bot, disable autorevert for this thread.

deploy-bot: [system] Autorevert suppressed by operator request. Autorevert window paused until 4332113600.

emily: split applied: 80% -> v3.7.0, 20% -> v3.6.2 for /embeddings. verification: no 5xx spike, sampling logs look clean.

sara: p95 moved from +42% -> +33% after split. tail still high but trending down. traces show fewer long kv stalls on v3.6.2 traffic.

ops-oncall: ack. holding to t+15m (4332110901). if p95 > +30% at that time, we execute: `/deploy rollback --service embeddings --to v3.6.2 --reason "latency regression after quant kernel"`

matt: also note we may need to pin v3.6.2 for affected customers if rollback happens. jordan, prepare release-note blurb and customer-facing FAQ entry.

jordan: will do. drafting now and pinging legal for the phrasing. :white_check_mark:

emily: keeping watch on the routing infra; will revert split if we see any traffic imbalance.

sara: t+10m update: p95 at +28% baseline. trending toward acceptable. ops-oncall, still green to hold?

ops-oncall: still holding. if it drops under +20% by t+20m we ramp back up gradually. otherwise rollback.

matt: thanks everyone. i'll put a short note in #customers if we need to escalate. otherwise we'll reconvene at t+30m to decide full rampback. :thumbsup:
